title: When it sells out while you are typing your card in
variant: Browser frames, and one small surface among four big ones
prompt: Show me what a ticket checkout should do when the event sells out mid-purchase. Right now it dumps you back to the event page and you lose the form.
note: The widest frames the template draws, 1280x800 in browser chrome, and the one that shows a helper earning its place: `checkout()` renders the same form three times so frames 2, 3 and 4 differ only in the banner and the sidebar, which is exactly what a reader has to be able to see. Frame 5 is 480x320 because a release notice is a small thing and drawing it window-sized would be a lie about it; that mix is what the `w`/`h` overrides exist for. The failure state is the whole page, and the settled/open ledger names the one assumption it rests on -- that the card details are still re-submittable -- rather than hiding it.
